title: Lift enhancement of a butterfly-like flapping wing vehicle by reinforcement learning algorithm.
summary: The policy learned on a force-sensor platform; follow-up experiments examined a newly observed lift peak. Validation is mounted-wing measurement, not demonstrated free flight.

evidence.tested: The policy learned on a force-sensor platform; follow-up experiments examined a newly observed lift peak. Validation is mounted-wing measurement, not demonstrated free flight.
evidence.unknown: The date refers to the cited version. Earlier public versions and independent replication were not systematically verified.
evidence.ai_role: Actor-critic proximal policy optimization is the AI method documented in the editorial source review.
